# AB-029: A hydroxide suspension and its clear filtrate hide different reserves
# Design only: predictions below are not measured observations.
register lv3
add v1 water 100mL
add v1 Mg(OH)2 0.002mol
new
add v2 water 100mL
add v2 Mg(OH)2 0.002mol
new
filter v2 v3
measure v1 ph
measure v3 ph
add v1 HCl 0.001mol
add v3 HCl 0.001mol
measure v1 ph
measure v3 ph
inspect
original_forecast: The suspension can replenish dissolved hydroxide by consuming solid Mg(OH)2. Its filtrate lacks that reserve and should acidify much more under the same acid dose.

original_acceptance_checks.criterion: Initial dissolved-state pH values are compared before the challenge.
Acid causes loss of hydroxide solid in v1 while the isolated filtrate becomes substantially more acidic.

execution_policy: Exactly one unchanged script invocation on changed reviewed-source artifact; no retry after issued marker. Preserve raw failure as well as success. No local native/build execution.
qualification: Native CLI replay in disposable remote microVM, not a REST gateway or production deployment acceptance; empirical heat/rate calibration remains separate.
